implementation.behavior: Request-local checked_read cache snapshots exact plain JSON dict/list/scalar values and root tuples whose elements are plain JSON to strict UTF-8 bytes; each cache hit restores independent values and reconstructs root tuple type. Nested tuples, sqlite3.Row, custom objects, non-finite floats, invalid surrogate code units, or too-deep JSON values retain the prior _copy path.
preserved_boundaries: No cache crosses checked_action/source_scope or DB identity.
Cache remains limited to in-transaction reads.
db.total_changes still clears cached values after a write.
Fresh currentness/source reads, request validation, permission/expiry checks, and cross-action revalidation unchanged.
Cycle, depth, node-count, and read-only storage mutation guards unchanged.

limitation: No post-change cProfile on pinned source-v7 image has been run. Unit tests establish cache-hit copy reduction for the covered JSON/root-tuple shapes and exact Unicode compatibility; they do not establish end-to-end speedup, acceptance, or workload-level performance.
